blocks.text: ASEAN Women Economic Summit GALA NIGHT / BABAE Awards 2026 welcomed distinguished delegates from across ASEAN, government officials, business leaders, women entrepreneurs, industry partners, advocates, and friends who share a common vision of empowering women and advancing inclusive economic growth. Welcome Remarks by Rosemarie Bosch – Ong, President, Women Business Council Philippines and Co-Chair of AWES Philippines 2026, and a special toast to mark a meaningful gathering were led by the Chairperson of WomenBizPH and Chairperson of AWES Philippines 2026, Ms. Rhoda Castro-Caliwara, together with the WomenBizPH Board of Directors.
